name: DerivedCategory.map_triangleOfSESδ
statement: ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)} (hS : S.ShortExact) : dsimp% F.mapDerivedCategory.map (triangleOfSESδ hS) = (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app S.X₃) ≫ triangleOfSESδ (hS.map_of_exact (F.mapHomologicalComplex _)) ≫ (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app S.X₁)⟦1⟧' ≫ (F.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).inv.app (Q.obj S.X₁)
